findings.capability: NOT DEMONSTRATED. Requests were streamed with reasoning enabled and tools declared (tool_choice auto, provider Alibaba). findings.whyNotCalled: The EVIDENCE_FIRST reasoning states the decision in its own words: both responses say no tool call is needed because the evidence is in the prompt, then give the JSON answer. The instruction to call tools first was read and not followed. One factor to test next: every V6 request sets response_format json_object, while F1Q's tool-calling arm (9/10) was built without it; see p7.f1q.response-format-crosstab.v1.json.
